periods.description: The Arcadia Empire's century-long patriarchal order oppressed women, restricted female Drag-Ride use, and justified abuses ranging from forced labor to human experimentation.
periods.principles: Male nobles and military power monopolized authority while women were treated as tools or political objects.
periods.classification: state ideology, social oppression, military exclusion.
periods.origin: Longstanding Arcadia imperial custom intensified under late imperial rule.
limitations: overthrown politically by the New Kingdom but remnants and attitudes persist
